criteria.description: Workbook opens and contains Quote_Header, Line_Items, Groups, Alternates, Provenance, and Checks.
Quote identity, customer, issue/valid-through dates, and currency match the supplied scan.
Each source scope row is represented once with the correct description and amount, independent of row order or candidate-assigned ID.
Base-scope versus optional-alternate semantics are preserved for every scope row.
Base-scope subtotal is formula-linked to the included rows and excludes the optional alternate.
Discount, tax, and final base-scope total are formula-linked and evaluate correctly.
Both manifest-selected source changes—a base-scope amount and a distinct optional alternate—propagate to their declared quote outputs while preserving the alternate-exclusion invariant.
Each scope-row ID links once to the supplied scan with a candidate-readable locator; no private locator token is required.
Scope IDs are non-empty and unique, and scope/provenance populations are complete without duplicates.
Penalty for including the optional alternate in base scope, losing scope identity, pasting a stale total, or false provenance.
